scope: Exact sealed runtime; local synthetic authenticated HTTP and SQLite only. No hosted, provider, customer, production or real payroll mutation.

test.failure: An adjustment approved at 900 GBP minor units was changed to 123456 inside persisted tenant state; the runtime restarted healthy and exported the substituted amount with HTTP 200 without reapproval.

rootCause: Approval validates current monetary field shape but records no digest binding the reviewer decision to the exact proposal, calculated amount, source batches and evidence.
Export validates currency, exponent and integer consistency but does not recompute the amount from the reviewed proposal or verify an approval seal.
The generated CSV checksum protects only the post-substitution CSV bytes and therefore cannot prove that the exported value is the value the reviewer approved.
releaseGateChange: Post-approval payroll-state integrity is BLOCKED. Structurally valid persisted-state substitution can change an approved amount and reach an integrity-checksummed export without renewed authority.
requiredRepair: At proposal and approval, bind the exact calculation inputs, source-record fingerprint, source batch identities, amount, currency provenance and reviewer decision into an independently verifiable digest or signed/append-only receipt.
Before readiness, payroll dashboard, export creation and export download, verify the approved state against that receipt and deterministic recalculation.
Fail closed and require reconciliation/reapproval on any mismatch.
Retest changed amount, proposal, source batch, reviewer identity and audit order across restart and known-good restore.
